definitions.gloss: monthly fee; monthly charge; monthly amount
definitions.explanation: A recurring payment or charge that is billed every month, commonly used for subscriptions, memberships, and services.

examples.japanese: {月額|げつがく}500⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{利用|りよう}できる→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: You can use it for 500 yen per month.

examples.japanese: {月額|げつがく}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくらです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: How much is the monthly fee?

examples.japanese: ⟦サブスク→サブスク：05396_sabusuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{月額|げつがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}したら→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧、⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: When I reviewed my monthly subscription fees, I was able to save quite a bit.

notes:
{月額|げつがく} combines {月|げつ} (month) + ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount). Very common in subscription and pricing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月額|げつがく}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: monthly fee
- {月額|げつがく}⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧: monthly plan
- {月額|げつがく}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: monthly billing system
- {月額|げつがく}○○⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: ○○ yen per month

USAGE:
Often used adverbially to modify an amount: {月額|げつがく}500⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (500 yen/month). Very common in advertisements, contracts, and service descriptions.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{年額|ねんがく}→年額：22568_nengaku⟧: annual amount
- {日額|にちがく}: daily amount
- ⟦{定額|ていがく}→定額：09740_teigaku⟧: flat rate, fixed amount
- ⟦サブスク→サブスク：05396_sabusuku⟧: subscription (abbreviation of ⟦サブスクリプション→サブスクリプション：08617_sabusukuripushon⟧)
